# AI Acknowledgement {.unnumbered}

Generative AI was used extensively throughout this project. AI systems supported research planning, literature discovery, software development, benchmark infrastructure, repository maintenance, data analysis, manuscript drafting and restructuring, language revision, and review. Substantial portions of the project code and manuscript were generated or revised with AI assistance. The table summarizes the tools and underlying models used to produce the work.

| Tool / interface | Underlying authoring models | Project role |
|---|---|---|
| ChatGPT | GPT-5.6 Sol; GPT-5.6 Luna; GPT-6 Sol; GPT-6 Luna | Research planning, literature discovery, analysis, drafting, revision, and review. |
| Claude Code | Claude Opus 5; Claude Opus 5.5 | Software development, benchmark and repository work, manuscript support, and review. |
| Codex CLI | GPT-5.6 Luna; GPT-5.6 Sol; GPT-6 Luna; GPT-6 Sol | Software development, repository maintenance, analysis, and review. |
| OpenCode V2 | GPT-5.6 Sol | Limited software development and repository work. |
| Pi | GPT-5.6 Luna; Claude Opus 5; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash | Software development, benchmark and repository work, and analysis. |

: AI tools and models used to produce the project. {#tbl-ai-authoring-tools}
